targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM click_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM click_events WHERE outcome = 'hit' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM click_events WHERE outcome = 'miss' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(DISTINCT client_ip) AS value FROM click_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '$__interval') AS time, outcome AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM click_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, outcome ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top links (hits)
panels.description: Per link in the time range: how often it was hit, the internal description of where the link is physically used (redirects.description), and where it forwarded to — the click-time destination logged in click_events (falling back to the link's current destination for clicks older than 2026-08-30).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(ce.label, ce.path) AS link, count(*) AS hits, r.description AS "used on", coalesce((array_remove(array_agg(ce.redirect_url ORDER BY ce.ts DESC), NULL))[1], min(r.redirect_url)) AS "forwarded to" FROM click_events ce LEFT JOIN redirects r ON r.path_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(ce.path, 'UTF8')), 'hex') WHERE ce.outcome = 'hit' AND $__timeFilter(ce.ts) GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: All links (registry)
panels.description: Every registered link, ignoring the dashboard time range: description (where it's used), current destination, and all-time hits. Links that were never clicked show their label as the link.

targets.rawSql: WITH hits AS (SELECT path, count(*) AS n, max(ts) AS last_hit FROM click_events WHERE outcome = 'hit' GROUP BY path), hashed AS (SELECT path, n, last_hit, encode(sha256(convert_to(path, 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS ph FROM hits) SELECT coalesce(hashed.path, r.label) AS link, r.description AS "used on", r.redirect_url AS "currently forwards to", coalesce(hashed.n, 0) AS "hits (all time)", hashed.last_hit FROM redirects r LEFT JOIN hashed ON hashed.ph = r.path_hash ORDER BY coalesce(hashed.n, 0) DESC
SELECT client_ip, country, count(*) AS misses FROM click_events WHERE outcome = 'miss' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY misses DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT ts AS "time", outcome, path, label, redirect_url AS "forwarded to", client_ip, country, user_agent FROM click_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
